recap.text: Mongo pounces on a sleeping La Ciguapa and chomps her before she wakes, and she drops Damnation, a snare that discards an enemy totem when it times out, dead or not. Carl holds back against a muddy blob whose deck is tanks and snares. The blob hits Shi Maria with Damnation, and she times out chasing a mud ball, discarded and screaming. Snares freeze and kill Raul and Asojano, and a mud ball explodes over the rest.

beats.headline: Dropped by La Ciguapa
beats.text: Samantha smells something off the path, and under a pile of dead undergrowth at the foot of a kapok tree Mongo pounces on a sleeping hairy woman with backward feet and chomps her before she fully wakes. La Ciguapa, legendary, charming and hard to kill except by pets: a wasted chance for the deck. But she drops two cards. One is an uncommon snare called Damnation, which sends an enemy totem to the discard pile once it times out, whether it is dead or not. Good against powerful monsters they could not otherwise kill.
beats.gist: Mongo chomps the sleeping La Ciguapa, who drops Damnation, a snare card that discards an enemy totem.

beats.headline: Turned on Shi Maria
beats.text: The second of three deck fights is against a muddy blob guy whose deck is all tanks and snares, and Carl holds back on purpose to see his strategy. The blob hits Shi Maria with the same Damnation card they own, and she wastes her time on a rolling mud ball with a high dodge. When she times out, the snare sends her to the discard pile, enraged and screaming. Other snares freeze Raul and Asojano, and both die. With no totems left, a mud ball rolls up and explodes over them, and they lose the fight.
beats.gist: Shi Maria's deck loses: snares discard her and freeze Raul and Asojano, then a mud ball explodes.
